name: Xiantao

queries.query: Xiantao China official cadastral parcel map land registration geoportal API
queries.result: No Xiantao-specific public anonymous parcel map/API was found. Results identified official Chinese cadastral/real-estate registration policy material and an official Hubei Natural Resources report about Xiantao registration services, but not a downloadable parcel feature service.

queries.query: 仙桃市 官方 不动产 登记 地籍图 宗地图 公开 地图 服务 API
queries.result: Official results confirmed the Xiantao real-estate registration center, online registration, the 2023 一码看图 function, and later visual map querying. The search did not expose an anonymous parcel feature endpoint, response schema, CRS, or safe parcel identifier.

queries.query: 仙桃 一码看图 不动产 入口; 仙桃 不动产登记 以图查房 网址; site:hbzwfw.gov.cn 仙桃 不动产登记
queries.result: Search results described the 湖北政务服务网/鄂汇办 online registration and query channels, but no directly callable Xiantao public map/API URL was returned. The descriptions indicate identity/official service workflows rather than anonymous parcel geometry access.

officialSources.operator: 仙桃市不动产登记中心 / Xiantao Real Estate Registration Center, under Xiantao Natural Resources and Urban-Rural Construction authority
officialSources.evidence: First-party Hubei Natural Resources report identifies the local registration center and states that Xiantao implemented online registration, 2023 一码看图 (QR-based viewing of property floor plans), and a later visual registration-information query mechanism. This is direct local-custodian evidence, not merely national agency prose.

officialSources.operator: 仙桃市自然资源和规划局 / Xiantao Natural Resources and Planning Bureau
officialSources.evidence: First-party Hubei Natural Resources report attributed to Xiantao's bureau describes the local real-estate registration online hall and information-sharing platform; it does not publish an anonymous parcel geometry service.

officialSources.operator: 中国仙桃网 / Credit China Xiantao municipal publication
officialSources.evidence: Official Xiantao municipal publication says the city data middle platform aggregates natural-resource/registration-related data and APIs for internal/public-service workflows, but it does not expose parcel features or a public parcel endpoint.

officialSources.operator: Ministry of Natural Resources / State Council government publication
officialSources.evidence: National policy says cadastral data may be visualized through public geographic platforms where lawful; it is general national guidance and not evidence of an open Xiantao parcel layer.

remainingUncertainty: Xiantao clearly has a local real-estate registration center and online/map-viewing workflows, but the discovered routes are service descriptions or identity-mediated applications. The current public JavaScript/configuration did not expose an anonymous parcel feature API, schema, CRS, stable native parcel identity, or geometry response.
